question: Why do the worlds display such manifold diversity?
premises: The divisions within that awareness are abundant.
The worlds attain variegation from this abundance of divisions.
No transgression of this explanatory principle is accepted.
inference: The diversity of worlds is explained by the multiplicity of divisions within awareness, without invoking any other principle.
plain_english: For this very reason, because of the abundance of its divisions, the worlds too become variegated; and no transgression of this explanation is accepted.
